extracted.intended_audience: researchers, grant administrators, policy analysts, and historians interested in NSF awards and fellowship recipients (FY1972)
extracted.subtask_short: NSF fellowship and program awards listing
extracted.subtask_description: A historical, tabulated listing of National Science Foundation program awards and individual fellowship/traineeship recipients for fiscal year 1972, showing institution/recipient, project or field, program code, award duration (months), and dollar amounts. Useful as a reference/dataset of awards by state, institution, and program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award-entry bibliographic/reporting fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Each program award entry lists: institution or organization; principal investigator or named individual; project or activity title; program code in parentheses; duration in months; and dollar amount. The fellowship listing gives name and field of study, state of permanent residence, and program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples in the text: 'LOGSDON, JOHN M; SCIENCE, TECHNOLOGY AND PUBLIC POLICY (SOJ/ V 86 MONTHS $64,900' and the fellowship table heading: 'Name and Field of Study of Individuals Offered National Science Foundation Fellowships by State of Permanent Residence and Program, Fiscal Year 1972'. Use these fields as the canonical columns for the dataset: name, field_of_study, state, institution (for program awards), project_title, program_code, months, amount.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notation for award duration indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Three-year awards are indicated by 'f'; two-year awards are indicated by '*'; all others are 1-year awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim note from page: 'Three-year awards are indicated by "f;" the second and third years are renewable during any 2 of the following 4 years, subject to the student's satisfactory progress and the availability of funds. Two-year awards are indicated by "*". All otherl are t-year awards.' (text contains OCR errors; meaning: 'All others are 1-year awards').

rubrics_metrics.name: Renewal conditions for multi-year fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: Renewal of the second and third years of three-year awards is contingent on satisfactory student progress and availability of funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim: 'the second and third years are renewable during any 2 of the following 4 years, subject to the student's satisfactory progress and the availability of funds.' This is the explicit eligibility/administrative condition for continuation of multi-year fellowships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award classification / program category headings
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards are organized under program/category headings (examples include: 'PLANNING AND POLICY STUDIES AND INTERGOVERNMENTAL SCIENCE PROGRAMS', 'FELLOWSHIP AND TRAINEESHIP AWARDS', 'STUDIES OF INTERACTIONS OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY WITH SOCIETY').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These headings function as classification dimensions for grouping entries by program area; use them to categorize or filter the dataset by program/discipline area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monetary and temporal reporting standard
rubrics_metrics.description: Each award entry reports both the dollar amount and duration (in months) of the award, e.g., '12 MONTHS $60,000'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When interpreting amounts/durations, note OCR artifacts in the text (e.g., misplaced characters). Monetary values and months are the canonical quantitative descriptors of each award and should be parsed as numeric fields (months: integer, amount: currency).
